blockingFindings.finding: A hash/byte-valid one-second MP4 was accepted with caller-declared durationMs=10000. A 9000 ms annotation, metrics receipt and comparison then passed with sourceFilesVerified=true and a favourable directional delta.

verifyUnityWebGlRoot accepts arbitrary loader/data/framework/WASM and index bytes when a caller-authored manifest copies the current build ID and Unity-source digest and self-hashes those payloads. captureWeb passes this provenance gate and stops only later at served-byte fetch.

Android capture serializes only ro.build.version.release and SDK. Different fingerprints/security-patch builds can therefore have identical environment.os values and receive direction despite v2 requiring the same Android OS build.

The v2 artifact/material defect method omits the master prompt's visible-player category and refers to a completed checklist that is not frozen. Text-legibility uses per-package declared thresholds rather than one frozen threshold contract.

limitations: Android validators and source flow passed synthetic adversarial checks; fresh device execution remains unverified.
Web/WebGL binding primitives and the pre-browser provenance gate passed; a real served runtime was not launched in this audit.
The fourteen newly registered measures are emitted fail-closed as NOT_AVAILABLE until their registered calculation implementations and qualifying evidence exist.
Android OS identity records release/API rather than an exact build fingerprint/security patch; the active preregistration requires the same Android OS build.
This PASS does not certify Gate A/B/C, CERI, player experience, competitor superiority, physical-device behavior or human results.
